name: standing single leg calf raise (on a staircase)
description: One-legged calf raise from a stair step for a deep stretch. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Stand on the edge of a stair on one foot, holding the rail for balance.
Let your heel drop below the step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.
